question: Does the original use a real planar reflection (mirror camera + render target) or a mirrored clone of the cyclist? The stills can't distinguish the two.
probes: none from stills — REQUEST.md already states the preference: real planar reflection preferred, mirrored clone acceptable fallback
resolution: Implemented the request's preferred technique: a real planar reflection — the camera mirrored across the sea plane renders the scene (sea and veil hidden) into a half-resolution render target with tone mapping disabled, and the sea shader samples it through a texture-projection matrix with ripple distortion and a soft blur, veiled by a translucent procedural cloud layer. Verified in the final screenshot: the sea column averages track the mirrored sky column averages at all sampled x positions.
